cross_market.reason: Single EU type approval issued by Spain (E9*2007/46*3167) covers both markets; the current-regime 5P code TAN*34 + Va SBDUCBX0 + Ve ...VNML1BBAKL03 is registered in both ES and DE, so code-level identity exists in EEA. But (1) the ES commercial variant (Style MY26.5) is not officially linked to any TAN/Va/Ve (IDAE shows no code); (2) the seat.de page gives no TAN/Va/Ve/revision, and its ranges (27-31 g/km, 1.2-1.4 l/100 km) span EEA values of BOTH 5P (28-29, 1.2-1.3) and Sportstourer (29-31, 1.3-1.4), so it cannot be tied to one homologation, body or revision; (3) ES also has revision *35 not seen for the DE 5P. The 5.0-5.3 l/100 km charge-sustaining figure is plausibly the same EU type-approval value but identity is not demonstrable: at most PARTIAL, never EXACT.

separate_technical_variants: Old-regime rows (Ve ...WEML1..., revisions *30-*33, 7-9 g/km, 0.3-0.4 l/100 km, Z 156-164 Wh/km) vs current-regime rows (Ve ...VNML1..., revisions *34-*35, 28-31 g/km, 1.2-1.4 l/100 km, Z 128-132 Wh/km): same Va, different Ve emission segment (WE -> VN) and different PHEV weighting - must NOT be merged.
Ve suffix ...BBAKL03 vs ...BCAKL03 (5P): distinct versions (BCA: higher Mt, 127-128 km Zr, 160-162 Wh/km); BCA not seen for 5P in the new regime.
Mass in running order change within old regime: 1670 kg (*30/*31) vs 1657 kg (*32/*33/*34/*35).
Sportstourer = Va SFDUCBX0 (Cn 'SEAT LEON SP E-HYBRID150'): different variant, exclude.
Pre-FL 1.4 e-HYBRID (Ec 1395, Va SBDGEAX0, TAN *13-*27, Zr ~60-65 km): different technical variant, exclude.
CUPRA Leon (Va CBDUC*X0) shares TAN E9*2007/46*3167 but is a different make/variant: exclude.
missing_for_upgrade: An official document linking 'León 5P Style e-HYBRID MY26.5' to TAN/Va/Ve (CoC of a registered unit, ficha técnica ITV/tarjeta ITV fields 0.2/0.2.1, SEAT ES technical sheet listing type/variant/version, or an IDAE detail page with código de tipo/versión). For the cross-market data point: a seat.de/Pkw-EnVKV sheet or DE CoC stating TAN/Va/Ve (revision *34/*35, Ve ...VNML1BBAKL03) next to the 5.0-5.3 l/100 km figure.
notes: Re-homologation visible in EEA: 5P Va SBDUCBX0 revisions *30 (first reg. ES 2024-09-25) to *33 (from 2025-07-24) carry Ve ...WEML1... with 7-9 g/km and Fc 0.3-0.4 (matches ficha técnica nov-2024 / press kit 8-9 g/km, 0.4 l). Revision *34 (ES from 2025-11-10, DE from 2025-11-27) and *35 (ES from 2025-12-18) carry Ve ...VNML1... with 28-29 g/km, Fc 1.2-1.3, Z 128-132 Wh/km (matches tarifa ene/may-2026 27-31 g/km and seat.de 12.8-13.0 kWh/100 km). The emission segment change WE->VN plus the jump in weighted CO2/fuel with ~unchanged Zr is consistent with the new PHEV utility factor (Euro 6e-bis), but the EEA does not name the regulation, so that cause is inference. 2025 data are provisional (Status P). IDAE's MY26.5 Style detail (id 608422) still shows 0,30 l / 8 g/km (old regime) and 85 kW electric, 1.456 mm height, 5 seats. The EEA does not include the charge-sustaining fuel figure. dauto.ch (Swiss type-certificate site, secondary, not evidence) lists e9*2007/46-2019/543*3167 for Leon SP eHybrid. Tarifa code 'KL' comes from the DC file (T1), not re-verified in this session, so manufacturer_type_code is left null.
